title: Regression: the Part Library source label shows in the estimate, part sale, PO, return and credit lookups
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-E1 (exists only in the Part Library, never received here); SO = the number of the seeded special-order request received within the last 12 months at this location, and {vendor} = the vendor of its most recent delivery. Close each document without saving after reading the lookup.
custom_steps:
1. Estimates > open or create an estimate > Add Part > type "QAPL-E1".
  2. In the same estimate lookup, type SO.
  3. Part sales > open or create a part sale > Add Part > type "QAPL-E1".
  4. Purchase orders > open or create a PO > add a line > type "QAPL-E1" in the part field.
  5. Parts > Returns > Create Return > the part lookup > type "QAPL-E1".
  6. Parts > Returns > Create Credit > the part lookup > type "QAPL-E1".
custom_expected:
1. The QAPL-E1 option shows the subtitle "Part Library"; no "Catalog" label.
  2. The SO option shows "Part Library · {vendor}".
  3. The QAPL-E1 option shows "Part Library"; no "Catalog" label.
  4. The QAPL-E1 option shows "Part Library"; no "Catalog" label.
  5. Every result that comes from the Part Library (QAPL-E1 when the lookup offers it) shows "Part Library"; no "Catalog" label anywhere in the lookup.
  6. Every result that comes from the Part Library (QAPL-E1 when the lookup offers it) shows "Part Library"; no "Catalog" label anywhere in the lookup.
